messages.author: f3d71ca39a57d9c3
messages.subject: Outputs from INLA model
parts:
Hi folks,

I was wondering if anyone could provide the code for, or point me to some material with the code for getting some outputs from a completed INLA model. Specifically i am looking for:

- extracting the AUC, Kappa, sensitivity and specificity metrics. 
- extracting the predicted y (in my case cpue) so i can plot as a raster on GIS, as a map of habitat suitability.

I suppose it may be worth mentioning that the model i ran is a two part spatial ZAP GAM.

Thanks in advance.

Sophie
